title: RadiationAlert
description: Schema for alerts on the radiation.alerts Kafka topic, produced by the Flink alert operators (M3). Two kinds, distinguished by 'reason': 'sustained-high' (one record per sensor per sliding window with >= the configured DANGER readings) and 'rising-trend' (one record per geohash cell whose cpm_avg rose across N aggregation windows).

sensor_id.description: Sensor that triggered the alert (Device ID from Safecast CSV).

reason.description: Why the alert fired. 'sustained-high' = repeated DANGER readings within the sliding window. 'rising-trend' = a geohash cell's cpm_avg rose across N consecutive aggregation windows.

window_start.description: Inclusive start of the sliding event-time window (based on captured_at) in which the alert fired.

window_end.description: Exclusive end of the sliding event-time window.

cpm.description: Peak CPM reading among the DANGER-classified readings in the window.

breach_count.description: On 'sustained-high' alerts: number of DANGER-classified readings in the window (>= the configured min-breaches threshold). On 'rising-trend' alerts: number of consecutive rising aggregation windows behind the trend.

trend.description: Present on 'rising-trend' alerts: the supporting per-cell cpm_avg series. Absent on 'sustained-high' alerts.

window_count.description: Number of consecutive rising aggregation windows.

cpm_series.description: The cpm_avg values across the rising windows, oldest first.

delta.description: Total rise across the series (last minus first cpm_avg).

classification.description: Classification that triggered the alert. Always DANGER for sustained-high alerts.

latitude.description: Latitude of the latest breaching reading, so the map can place the alert.

longitude.description: Longitude of the latest breaching reading.

triggered_at.description: On 'sustained-high' alerts: captured_at of the latest breaching reading in the window (event time of the most recent breach). On 'rising-trend' alerts: window_end of the latest rising aggregation window.

geohash.description: Geohash cell (same precision as radiation.aggregated) of the alert's breach location, used to join the alert to its aggregated region stats. Null when the alert has no coordinates.

hot_region.description: Additive 'hot region' context: stats of the alert's geohash cell from radiation.aggregated, joined in by the Flink alert-region-join operator (M3). Null when no aggregation has been seen for the cell yet or the alert has no coordinates.

cpm_avg.description: Average CPM in the cell's latest aggregation window.

cpm_max.description: Peak CPM in the cell's latest aggregation window.

count.description: Number of readings in the cell's latest aggregation window.

worst_classification.description: Worst classification seen in the cell.

centroid_latitude.description: Latitude centroid of the cell's readings.

centroid_longitude.description: Longitude centroid of the cell's readings.
